object.name: base
object.prompt: Create an 8-frame spinning MELEE SLASH animation for a 64x64 pixel RPG hero. Transparent background, true handcrafted pixel art, crisp hard pixels, no blur, no text, no character. 96x96 fixed canvas and center pivot. This is a PHYSICAL WEAPON ATTACK, NOT a vortex. Show 2-3 separate curved blade trails rotating around the hero, with LARGE EMPTY TRANSPARENT SPACE in the center so the hero remains visible. Frames: 1 short blade trail begins, 2 second curved slash appears, 3 arcs rotate around hero, 4 multiple fast weapon trails, 5 peak impact with 3 separated crescent slashes surrounding hero, 6 trails break into small sharp fragments, 7 fragments fade, 8 disappear. White blade edges with small cyan highlights. Thin sharp crescents, strong directional motion. NEVER draw a filled circle, spiral, whirlpool, tornado, portal, disc, magic ring, water, or solid center. NOT HERO JUST FX

rows.animation: Frames: 1 short blade trail begins, 2 second curve
